title: Campaign rules: durable rulings, house rules, and disputed-turn replay
description:
Objective
Add a campaign-owned rule layer for durable table rulings and intentional house rules. Rulings resolve published-source ambiguity or stable recurring interpretation questions; house rules override or supplement otherwise clear canonical behavior. Semantic content remains player-provided or player-approved prose.

Architecture
Preserve ADR 0017 separation: immutable rules packs contain canonical semantics plus source ambiguity metadata; canonical campaign history contains prose rulings/house rules and effective timing; the DM model interprets pack semantics, ambiguity metadata, and active campaign prose; the audit model evaluates against the exact same active prose. Deterministic code owns identity, campaign association, kind, status, provenance, effective position, ordering, supersession/revocation, context delivery, and rollback/replay timing.

Scope
Cover domain/precedence, durable storage, shared DM/auditor context, explicit and implicit known-ambiguity resolution, management workflows, immediate disputed-turn rollback/replay, and end-to-end proof. Initial context delivery supplies all active campaign-rule prose to both models for correctness.

Non-goals
Do not compile arbitrary rule prose into deterministic mechanics. Do not store campaign choices in immutable rules packs. Do not let the DM silently select a canonical winner for source ambiguity. Do not auto-create house rules from attempts that conflict with clear canonical rules. Do not persist one-off contextual judgments such as line of sight, cover from rubble, terrain suitability, or similar fictional adjudication. Do not support arbitrary historical retroactivity.

References
ADR 0017; docs/rules-pack-compiler.md; PR #419 / eshyra-o9bd.18.7.9 RulesAmbiguity metadata, including Create Undead and Find Familiar; existing campaign binding eshyra-x3w.12; auditor eshyra-oobh; audited-turn staging eshyra-67qo; rollback/checkpoint foundations eshyra-c07.8 and eshyra-7wc.5.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are complete. Campaign rules are durable prose with deterministic identity/timing/precedence; DM and auditor receive equivalent active sets; unresolved pack ambiguities can become explicit or accepted implicit rulings; immediate objections can replay the disputed turn; canonical-rule conflicts never become inferred house rules; no ordinary contextual adjudication creates a campaign rule.
notes: All children closed. Epic deliverables landed on main across PR #524 (children .1-.3), #526 (.4-.6), #536 (.7-.9), and #537 (.2.5, the deferred campaign_rule index audit; merge commit e127bd0). Closing the epic.
